examples.en: My favourite food is noodles.
examples.zh: 我最喜欢的食物是面条。

examples.en: We bought food for the picnic.
I eat an apple every day.
These apples are sweet and juicy.
Monkeys love bananas.
I put a banana in my milkshake.
examples.zh: 我在奶昔里加了一根香蕉。

mnemonic.tip: banana 里三个 a 排成一排，像一串弯弯的香蕉。

examples.en: Would you like an orange or an apple?
A glass of orange juice, please.

mnemonic.tip: 一词两义：水果橙子和颜色橙色，橙子就是橙色的。

examples.en: Grandma grows grapes in her garden.
I like green grapes best.

mnemonic.tip: grape 和 great 就差一点：葡萄一串串，味道 great！

examples.en: This pear is very juicy.
We picked pears from the tree.

mnemonic.tip: pear(梨) 和 pair(一双) 同音：买梨常买一对。

examples.en: Strawberry ice cream is my favourite.
examples.zh: 草莓冰淇淋是我的最爱。

examples.en: We picked strawberries on the farm.

mnemonic.tip: straw(稻草)+berry(浆果)→铺着稻草种的浆果，就是草莓。

examples.en: We eat watermelon in hot summer.
examples.zh: 炎热的夏天我们吃西瓜。

examples.en: This watermelon is really big!

mnemonic.tip: water(水)+melon(瓜)→水分超多的瓜，就是西瓜。

examples.en: Lemons are too sour to eat.
I like tea with lemon.

mnemonic.tip: 谐音"了檬"：一口柠檬酸得"不得了"。

examples.en: The peaches are soft and sweet.
Would you like a peach?

mnemonic.tip: peach 和 beach(海滩)一字之差：夏天在海滩吃桃子最惬意。

examples.en: Mango juice is thick and sweet.
She bought two mangoes at the market.
examples.zh: 她在市场买了两个芒果。

mnemonic.tip: mango 音译就是"芒果"，中文名字直接从英语来。

examples.en: Do you like pineapple on pizza?
examples.zh: 你喜欢披萨上放菠萝吗？

examples.en: The pineapple smells wonderful.

mnemonic.tip: pine(松树)+apple(苹果)→长得像松果的"苹果"，就是菠萝。

examples.en: Eat more fruit and vegetables.
What fruit do you like best?

mnemonic.tip: fruit 一般不可数：a piece of fruit 一个水果，fruits 多指多个种类。

examples.en: Carrots are my favourite vegetable.
examples.zh: 胡萝卜是我最喜欢的蔬菜。

examples.en: Dad cooks vegetables for dinner.

mnemonic.tip: vege 部分音近"喂脆"：蔬菜喂进嘴里脆脆的。

examples.en: Chips are made from potatoes.
We planted potatoes in spring.

mnemonic.tip: potato、tomato 复数都加 es：potatoes、tomatoes。

examples.en: I love tomato and egg soup.
The tomatoes turned red in the sun.
examples.zh: 西红柿在阳光下变红了。

mnemonic.tip: potato 土豆、tomato 番茄只差开头：土豆的"红脸亲戚"就是西红柿。

examples.en: Rabbits like eating carrots.
Cut the carrots into small pieces.

mnemonic.tip: carrot 里的 rr 像兔子的两只长耳朵，兔子最爱胡萝卜。

examples.en: Cutting onions makes me cry.
Add some onion to the soup.

mnemonic.tip: 谐音"阿年"：阿年切洋葱，眼泪流一年。

examples.en: Green beans are good for you.
Jack planted a magic bean.
examples.zh: 杰克种下了一颗魔法豆。

mnemonic.tip: 《杰克与豆茎》的 bean：一颗豆子长到天上去。

examples.en: I had a fruit salad for lunch.
Mum made a big salad for the picnic.
examples.zh: 妈妈为野餐做了一大盆沙拉。

mnemonic.tip: salad 音译就是"沙拉"，蔬菜水果拌一拌。

examples.en: We eat rice almost every day.
Would you like rice or noodles?

mnemonic.tip: rice 不可数：a bowl of rice 一碗米饭，不说 rices。

examples.en: I had a big bowl of noodles.
Grandpa makes noodles by hand.

mnemonic.tip: noodles 常用复数：面条是一根一根的，当然不止一根。

examples.en: I had bread and milk for breakfast.
examples.zh: 我早餐吃了面包和牛奶。

examples.en: This bread is still warm.

mnemonic.tip: bread 不可数：一片面包是 a piece/slice of bread。

examples.en: Pasta with tomato sauce is easy to cook.
The restaurant is famous for its pasta.

mnemonic.tip: 音译"帕斯塔"：意大利面在西餐厅菜单上就叫帕斯塔。

examples.en: I have cereal with milk in the morning.
This cereal has too much sugar.

mnemonic.tip: 谐音"喜瑞尔"：早餐来碗麦片，一天都欢喜顺利。

examples.en: I like toast with butter and jam.
examples.zh: 我喜欢抹黄油和果酱的烤面包。

examples.en: Two pieces of toast, please.

mnemonic.tip: 谐音"吐司"：中文"吐司"就是从 toast 音译来的。

examples.en: Mum baked a chocolate cake.
examples.zh: 妈妈烤了一个巧克力蛋糕。

examples.en: We shared the birthday cake.
Would you like a biscuit with your tea?
The dog gets a biscuit when it sits.
examples.zh: 狗狗坐下就能得到一块饼干。

mnemonic.tip: 谐音"比斯吉"：英式饼干叫 biscuit，美式叫 cookie。

examples.en: Don't eat too many sweets.
This mango is really sweet.

mnemonic.tip: 一词两义：名词是糖果(英式)，形容词是甜的；美式糖果叫 candy。

examples.en: Hot chocolate is nice in winter.
examples.zh: 冬天喝热巧克力很舒服。

examples.en: He gave me a box of chocolates.

mnemonic.tip: 谐音"巧克力"：中文名就是音译，读的时候只有三个音节 /ˈtʃɒk-lət/。

examples.en: Two ice creams, please.
Chocolate ice cream is the best.

mnemonic.tip: ice(冰)+cream(奶油)→冰的奶油，就是冰淇淋。

examples.en: Grandma's apple pie smells great.
examples.zh: 奶奶的苹果派闻起来真香。

examples.en: We had meat pie for dinner.

mnemonic.tip: 谐音"派"：苹果派就是 apple pie，音译词最好记。

examples.en: Fruit is a healthy snack.
We had a snack before the game.
examples.zh: 比赛前我们吃了点零食。

mnemonic.tip: snack 和 snake(蛇)一字之差：蛇偷吃零食，别拼混了。

examples.en: Squirrels keep nuts for winter.
This cake has nuts in it.

mnemonic.tip: doughnut(甜甜圈)里也有 nut：长得像坚果的面圈。

examples.en: We make dumplings at Spring Festival.
These dumplings taste wonderful.

mnemonic.tip: 谐音"当扑铃"：饺子下锅"当"地一声扑进水里。

examples.en: Do you take sugar in your tea?
Too much sugar is bad for your teeth.

mnemonic.tip: sugar 的 s 读 /ʃ/：和 sure 一样，都是"嘘"的音。

examples.en: The soup needs a little salt.
Pass me the salt, please.

mnemonic.tip: salt(盐) 和 salty(咸的)：加了 salt 味道就 salty。

examples.en: Add some pepper to the eggs.
Red peppers are good in salad.

mnemonic.tip: pepper 念起来"噗噗"的，像撒胡椒粉时打喷嚏。

examples.en: Heat some oil in the pan first.
Olive oil is good for salads.
I like chips with tomato sauce.
The pasta sauce smells delicious.

mnemonic.tip: 音译"少司"：老上海把西餐酱汁叫"少司"，就是 sauce。

examples.en: I spread strawberry jam on my toast.
examples.zh: 我在吐司上抹了草莓酱。

examples.en: Grandma makes her own jam.

mnemonic.tip: traffic jam(堵车)也用 jam：车像果酱一样黏在路上。

examples.en: Bees make honey from flowers.
I put honey in my warm milk.
examples.zh: 我在热牛奶里加了蜂蜜。

mnemonic.tip: honey 也是甜甜的称呼"亲爱的"：像蜂蜜一样甜的人。

examples.en: Spread some butter on the bread.
We need butter to make the cake.

mnemonic.tip: butter 里藏着 but：面包好吃，but 要抹黄油才香。

examples.en: Mice love cheese in cartoons.
examples.zh: 动画片里老鼠都爱奶酪。

examples.en: I'd like a cheese sandwich.
examples.zh: 我想要一个奶酪三明治。

mnemonic.tip: 拍照喊"cheese"：说这个词嘴角上扬，正好露出微笑。

examples.en: I have a boiled egg for breakfast.
The hen laid three eggs.
Tigers eat meat.
My aunt doesn't eat meat.

mnemonic.tip: meat(肉) 和 meet(遇见) 同音：中午遇见(meet)你去吃肉(meat)。

examples.en: Beef noodles are my favourite.
The beef is very soft and tasty.

mnemonic.tip: 牛是 cow，牛肉却是 beef——上桌就改名，别叫错。

examples.en: We had chicken and rice for lunch.
examples.zh: 我们午饭吃了鸡肉和米饭。

examples.en: The chickens are running in the yard.

mnemonic.tip: chicken 既是活的鸡也是鸡肉：可数是鸡，不可数是肉。

examples.en: These dumplings have pork inside.
Pork is cheaper than beef here.

mnemonic.tip: 猪是 pig，猪肉是 pork：p 开头一家人，上桌换名字。

examples.en: Fish and chips is a famous English meal.
examples.zh: 炸鱼薯条是有名的英国餐。

examples.en: There are five fish in the tank.

mnemonic.tip: fish 单复数同形：one fish, two fish，不加 s。

examples.en: We cooked sausages on the barbecue.
examples.zh: 我们在烧烤架上烤了香肠。

examples.en: The dog stole a sausage from the table!
examples.zh: 狗从桌上偷了一根香肠！

mnemonic.tip: 谐音"扫赛奇"：烤肠香味一飘，大家都来扫荡一根。

examples.en: A burger and chips, please.
Dad makes great burgers at home.
examples.zh: 爸爸在家做的汉堡特别棒。

mnemonic.tip: burger 音译"堡"：汉堡包的"堡"就是它。

examples.en: I made a cheese sandwich for the trip.
examples.zh: 我为旅行做了一个奶酪三明治。

examples.en: What's in your sandwich?
examples.zh: 你的三明治里夹了什么？

mnemonic.tip: sand(沙)+wich：传说三明治伯爵打牌太忙，把肉夹面包里边玩边吃。

examples.en: Let's order a big pizza tonight.
examples.zh: 今晚我们点个大披萨吧。

examples.en: My favourite pizza has extra cheese.
examples.zh: 我最喜欢的披萨要多加奶酪。

mnemonic.tip: pizza 读 /ˈpiːtsə/"皮擦"，注意 zz 读 /ts/ 不是 /z/。

examples.en: Fish and chips, please.
These chips are too salty.

mnemonic.tip: 英式 chips 是薯条，美式 chips 是薯片——KET 按英式记。

examples.en: Hot soup is great on a cold day.
Mum made chicken soup for me.

mnemonic.tip: soup 音近"漱噗"：喝汤时"噗"地吹一口气再喝。

examples.en: I drink a glass of milk before bed.
Do you want milk in your tea?
I have yogurt with fruit for breakfast.
Strawberry yogurt is her favourite.

mnemonic.tip: 谐音"优格"：台湾把酸奶叫优格，就是 yogurt。

examples.en: The cake has cream on top.
Would you like cream in your coffee?

mnemonic.tip: ice cream 里的 cream：冰+奶油=冰淇淋，奶油本人就是 cream。

examples.en: Drink more water every day.
A bottle of water, please.
Apple juice or orange juice?
Fresh juice is better than cola.

mnemonic.tip: 谐音“就是”：最好喝的饮料，就是(juice)果汁。

examples.en: English people drink tea with milk.
A cup of tea, please.

mnemonic.tip: tea 的发音来自闽南语"茶"(te)：这个英语词源自中国。

examples.en: Dad drinks coffee every morning.
This café makes great coffee.
examples.zh: 这家咖啡馆的咖啡很棒。

mnemonic.tip: coffee 音译"咖啡"：两个 f 两个 e，别少写。

examples.en: Cold lemonade is perfect in summer.
examples.zh: 夏天喝冰柠檬水最合适。

examples.en: She sells lemonade at the school fair.
examples.zh: 她在学校集市上卖柠檬水。

mnemonic.tip: lemon(柠檬)+ade(饮料后缀)→柠檬做的饮料，就是柠檬水。

examples.en: I ordered a banana milkshake.
The milkshake is too cold to drink fast.
examples.zh: 奶昔太凉了，不能喝太快。

mnemonic.tip: milk(牛奶)+shake(摇)→把牛奶摇一摇，就是奶昔。

examples.en: Cola has a lot of sugar in it.
A small cola with no ice, please.
examples.zh: 请来一杯小杯可乐，不加冰。

examples.en: Breakfast is an important meal.
We had a big meal at the restaurant.
examples.zh: 我们在餐馆吃了一顿大餐。

mnemonic.tip: meal 泛指"一顿饭"：三 meals = breakfast、lunch、dinner。

examples.en: I had eggs and toast for breakfast.
examples.zh: 我早餐吃了鸡蛋和吐司。

examples.en: Don't skip breakfast before school.

mnemonic.tip: break(打破)+fast(禁食)→睡一夜没吃，早上打破禁食，就是早餐。

examples.en: We have lunch at twelve.
What's for lunch today?
Dinner is ready! Come to the table.
We had fish for dinner.

mnemonic.tip: have dinner 吃晚饭不加 the；dinner 是一天中最正式的一餐。

examples.en: We had a light supper at eight.
examples.zh: 我们八点吃了顿简单的晚饭。

examples.en: Milk and biscuits make a nice supper.
examples.zh: 牛奶配饼干是不错的宵夜。

mnemonic.tip: supper 比 super(超级)多一个 p：超级饿的晚上多吃一点，就是晚饭。

examples.en: Let's have a picnic by the lake.
We packed sandwiches for the picnic.
examples.zh: 我们为野餐打包了三明治。

mnemonic.tip: 谐音"皮克尼克"：背上篮子去野餐，一路蹦蹦跳跳。

examples.en: We had a barbecue in the garden.
Dad cooked chicken on the barbecue.
examples.zh: 爸爸在烤架上烤了鸡肉。

mnemonic.tip: 缩写 BBQ 就是 barbecue：barbe-cue，烤肉排队(queue)等着吃。

examples.en: Can we see the menu, please?
There are ten dishes on the menu.

mnemonic.tip: 谐音"没牛"：翻遍菜单没牛肉？再看一遍 menu。

examples.en: We went to a new restaurant last night.
examples.zh: 我们昨晚去了一家新餐馆。

examples.en: This restaurant is famous for noodles.

mnemonic.tip: rest(休息)+aurant→逛累了休息吃饭的地方，就是餐馆。

examples.en: We had cake at a café near the park.
examples.zh: 我们在公园附近的咖啡馆吃了蛋糕。

examples.en: The café opens at nine.

mnemonic.tip: café 比 restaurant 小而随意，喝咖啡吃点心的小店。

examples.en: Are you ready to order?
I ordered a pizza online.
examples.zh: 我在网上订了一个披萨。

mnemonic.tip: 服务员必说 Are you ready to order?——KET 听力餐馆场景高频句。

examples.en: This fish dish is delicious.
Please help me wash the dishes.

mnemonic.tip: wash the dishes 洗碗：dishes 泛指餐具，不只是盘子。

examples.en: Put the cake on a plate.
He ate a whole plate of dumplings.

mnemonic.tip: plate 和 play 开头一样：别把盘子当玩具玩(play)。

examples.en: I ate a bowl of rice.
The cat's bowl is empty.

mnemonic.tip: bowl 的 o 圆圆的，就像一只圆圆的碗。

examples.en: A cup of tea, please.
Be careful, the cup is hot.

mnemonic.tip: cup 装热饮（茶/咖啡），glass 装冷饮（水/果汁）。

examples.en: We eat pasta with a fork.
The fork goes on the left.

mnemonic.tip: fork 的 f 竖起来就像一把小叉子。

examples.en: Cut the bread with a knife.
The knives are in the drawer.

mnemonic.tip: knife 的 k 不发音；复数 knives，f 变 v 加 es。

examples.en: Eat your soup with a spoon.
Add two spoons of sugar.

mnemonic.tip: spoon 里的 oo 像两个圆圆的勺头。

examples.en: Can you eat noodles with chopsticks?
My penfriend is learning to use chopsticks.

mnemonic.tip: chop(夹/砍)+sticks(小棍)→用来夹菜的小棍，就是筷子，成双用复数。

examples.en: I take a bottle of water to school.
The bottle is made of plastic.
We eat dinner at seven.
I ate too much cake yesterday.

mnemonic.tip: 不规则变化：eat→ate→eaten，吃过了就变样。

examples.en: Drink some water after running.
Would you like a hot drink?

mnemonic.tip: drink→drank→drunk，元音 i-a-u 一路变。

examples.en: My father cooks dinner on Sundays.
I am learning to cook eggs.
Boil the eggs for eight minutes.
The water is boiling now.

mnemonic.tip: 谐音"泡儿"：水烧开时咕嘟咕嘟冒泡儿。

examples.en: Fry the eggs in a little oil.
I love fried rice.

mnemonic.tip: fry 音近"弗来"：油一热"呲啦"响，香味飞来。

examples.en: We baked cookies for the school fair.
examples.zh: 我们为学校集市烤了饼干。

examples.en: Grandma bakes bread every weekend.

mnemonic.tip: bake 用烤箱烤（面包蛋糕），barbecue 用火烤（肉串）。

examples.en: This soup tastes great.
Can I taste your ice cream?
examples.zh: 我能尝尝你的冰淇淋吗？

mnemonic.tip: taste + 形容词：taste good/sweet 尝起来很好/甜，后面不加 ly。

examples.en: I'm hungry. What's for dinner?
The hungry cat is waiting by its bowl.

mnemonic.tip: hungry 里有 hung(挂)：饿得肚子"空挂"着。

examples.en: Running makes me thirsty.
I'm thirsty. Is there any juice?

mnemonic.tip: thirst(口渴)+y(形容词后缀)→渴的；hungry and thirsty 又饿又渴。

examples.en: No more, thanks. I'm full.
The bus was full this morning.
examples.zh: 今天早上公交车满员了。

mnemonic.tip: 一词两义：肚子满了是"饱"，车厢满了是"满"。

examples.en: The dumplings smell delicious.
Thank you for the delicious meal.

mnemonic.tip: 谐音"得力羞死"：这道菜好吃得让别的菜都害羞。

examples.en: The lemon is too sour!
The milk has gone sour.

mnemonic.tip: sour 音近"馊啊"：饭菜馊了就发酸。

examples.en: The market sells fresh vegetables.
I love the smell of fresh bread.
examples.zh: 我喜欢新鲜面包的味道。

mnemonic.tip: fresh air 新鲜空气、fresh fruit 新鲜水果：刚出炉刚摘下都叫 fresh。

examples.en: Would you like a piece of cake?
Take a piece of paper each.

mnemonic.tip: piece(块) 和 peace(和平) 同音：分蛋糕人人有份，世界和平。
